title: ByteDance bolsters Seedance 2.0 with watermarking, IP safeguards ahead of global roll-out | South China Morning Post
summary: ByteDance is enhancing its video-generation model Seedance 2.0 with watermarking and IP protection features for its global roll-out amid controversies over alleged IP theft. The company also partnered with C2PA for transparency in AI-generated content labeling on TikTok.
sentiment_reason: The company's proactive measures to address IP theft concerns and enhance content safety are seen as positive steps towards mitigating controversies and potentially improving its market standing.
